time_base_note: Every offset is software: this side has no trigger counter and no device clock. Simulated time is a coordinate of the model, not a clock reading, so it is recorded in trajectory_meta.json rather than as this log's time base (4.6.9).

arm_cost.note: the arm's cost from the plan's own per-arm numbers; the plan-level estimates are the sum over kept arms

reduced_units.note: length trap_width_1, energy k_B*T, time trap_width_1^2/D

events.note: the backend reports complete and no stop criterion fired
peak_rss is the operator process's high-water mark, which includes the backend running in it. particle_frame_cost covers readout only; a streaming backend's in-loop write is frame_write_wall_s
